credentials.title: APIs to enable in Google Cloud
credentials.intro: Enable these APIs in the site's Google Cloud project. Each name opens its console page.

recaptcha_enterprise.purpose: reCAPTCHA v2 and v3 verification on forms (contact, sign-up, checkout).

maps_javascript.purpose: Interactive maps and loading the Google Maps library in the browser.

places.purpose: Address autocomplete in forms (checkout, account, backend).

places_sync.purpose: Nightly sync of the location's opening hours and reviews from its Place ID.

directions.purpose: Routes drawn on maps, only when configured.

google_oauth.purpose: Sign in with Google: create a Web application OAuth client and copy its Client ID.
